project.name: [SANDBOX] Dogfood Small - Settings Button Fix
project.brief: Fix the disabled settings save button after a small form validation regression. Keep scope narrow, verify with the existing unit test, and do not create expanded-mode docs.
principles: Do not expand the project beyond the observed regression.
Verification must prove the button state changes correctly.

issues.title: Guide: Agent Operating Guide
issues.description:
## Objective
Preserve the original brief, dependency order, small-project non-scope, and next safest issue.

## Context
This is a narrow implementation task. Expanded-mode local docs are non-scope.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Original brief is visible in the ledger.
- First implementation issue is named.
- Continuous Discovery rule says blockers or correctness issues become follow-up issues only when required.

## Verification
Read back the project graph and ledger before implementation starts.

## Notes For Future Agents
Start with DOG-S-002. Keep any discovered non-blocking improvements as candidates.

issues.title: Implement settings save button validation fix
issues.description:
## Objective
Fix the disabled save button regression.

## Context
The form button should enable when required settings fields are valid.

## Scope
- Owned work: settings form validation code.
- Non-scope: unrelated UX copy, settings layout, or validation framework changes.

## Dependencies / Blockers
- Blocked by: DOG-S-001 operating guide.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Save button enables for valid fields.
- Invalid fields still keep the button disabled.

## Verification
Run the targeted settings form unit test and record the command output.

## Notes For Future Agents
Create a follow-up issue only if validation behavior is ambiguous or a failing test reveals a separate defect.

issues.title: Verify and close the small fix
issues.description:
## Objective
Close the project only after the targeted fix is verified.

## Context
Small projects still need a completion comment and ledger read-back.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Targeted test result is recorded.
- Ledger has final verification evidence.
- No expanded-mode artifacts were created.

## Verification
Run the targeted test and inspect the git diff for unrelated changes.

## Notes For Future Agents
If verification reveals another defect, classify it through Continuous Issue Discovery before closing.
